title: Harry the Dirty Dog
author: Gene Zion
intro: Harry is a white dog with black spots. He likes everything, except getting a bath!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What does Harry look like at the start?
questions.yes: Harry is a white dog with black spots.
Harry liked everything, except getting a bath.

questions.q: What does Harry bury in the back garden?
questions.clue: It is used to scrub dogs in the bath.
questions.yes: Harry buried the scrubbing brush in the back garden.

questions.q: Why does Harry bury the brush?

options.text: He thinks it is a bone

questions.clue: He heard the water running into the bath.
questions.yes: Harry buried the brush so he would not have a bath.

questions.q: What does Harry do after he buries the brush?
questions.clue: He leaves the house and goes off on his own.

options.text: Where they are fixing the street

questions.clue: Workers are mending the road there.
questions.yes: Harry played where they were fixing the street.

questions.q: What game does Harry play with other dogs?
questions.clue: You chase someone and touch them.
questions.yes: Harry played tag with other dogs.

questions.q: What makes Harry the dirtiest of all?
questions.yes: Harry slid down a coal chute and got the dirtiest of all.

questions.q: What does Harry look like when he is dirty?
questions.yes: Harry became a black dog with white spots.

questions.q: What happens when Harry gets home?
questions.clue: They think he is a strange dog.

questions.q: What does Harry do to show he is Harry?
questions.clue: He rolls over and plays dead.
questions.yes: Harry did all his old tricks, but the family still didn't know him.

questions.clue: It is the thing he buried at the start.
questions.yes: Harry dug up the scrubbing brush.

questions.q: Where does Harry run with the brush?
questions.clue: It is where dogs get washed.
questions.yes: Harry jumped into the bath with the brush in his mouth.

questions.q: What happens when the family washes the dirty dog?

options.text: They see that it is Harry
He turns bright pink all over

questions.clue: The dirt comes off, and his spots show again.
questions.yes: After a good scrub, the family shouted, "It's Harry!"

questions.q: Where does Harry hide the brush at the end?
questions.clue: He sleeps on top of it.
questions.yes: Harry hid the scrubbing brush under his pillow.
